summary: XCF Global filed an 8-K reporting termination of a purchase agreement with Helena Global Investment Opportunities I LTD. The agreement allowed XCF to sell up to $50M of common stock at a variable price (lowest intraday price over three trading days). Upon termination, ~55M shares previously reserved for issuance are no longer reserved, reducing potential dilution and overhang. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a termination of a financing agreement, not a special situation. What to watch: XCF retains flexibility for future financing.
